en: On February 1st, 1705, Sophie Charlotte dies at just 36 years old.
zh: 1705年2月1日，索菲·夏洛特在僅36歲時去世。
ja: 1705年2月1日、ゾフィー・シャルロッテはわずか36歳で亡くなりました。
local: On February 1st, 1705, Sophie Charlotte dies at just 36 years old.
ja_pron: 1705-nen 2-gatsu 1-nichi, Zofī Sharurotte wa wazuka 36-sai de nakunarimashita.
native: On February 1st, 1705, Sophie Charlotte dies at just 36 years old.

en: Her death comes completely unexpectedly.
zh: 她的去世完全出乎意料。
ja: 彼女の死は全く予期せぬものでした。
local: Her death comes completely unexpectedly.
ja_pron: Kanojo no shi wa mattaku yoki senu mono deshita.
native: Her death comes completely unexpectedly.

en: She dies far too young, leaving behind not only her husband Friedrich the first, but also
zh: 她去世得太年輕，不僅留下了她的丈夫弗里德里希一世，還有
ja: 彼女はあまりにも若くして亡くなり、夫のフリードリヒ1世だけでなく、
local: She dies far too young, leaving behind not only her husband Friedrich the first, but also
ja_pron: Kanojo wa amari ni mo wakaku shite nakunari, otto no Furīdorihi Issei dake de naku,
native: She dies far too young, leaving behind not only her husband Friedrich the first, but also

en: her son, who would later become King Friedrich Wilhelm.
zh: 她的兒子，後來成為國王弗里德里希·威廉。
ja: 後にフリードリヒ・ヴィルヘルム王となる息子も残しました。
local: her son, who would later become King Friedrich Wilhelm.
ja_pron: Ato ni Furīdorihi Viruherumu ō to naru musuko mo nokoshimashita.
native: her son, who would later become King Friedrich Wilhelm.

en: Sophie Charlotte was far more than a queen.
zh: 索菲·夏洛特不僅僅是一位女王。
ja: ゾフィー・シャルロッテは単なる女王以上の存在でした。
local: Sophie Charlotte was far more than a queen.
ja_pron: Zofī Sharurotte wa tannaru joō ijō no sonzai deshita.
native: Sophie Charlotte was far more than a queen.

en: She was an educated, intelligent woman who was in close exchange with scholars like
zh: 她是一位受過教育、聰明的女性，與像
ja: 彼女は教育を受けた知的な女性で、
local: She was an educated, intelligent woman who was in close exchange with scholars like
ja_pron: Kanojo wa kyōiku o uketa chiteki na josei de,
native: She was an educated, intelligent woman who was in close exchange with scholars like

en: Gottfried Wilhelm Leibniz, engaged in philosophical conversations, valued music and cultivated
zh: 哥特弗里德·威廉·萊布尼茲等學者密切交流，參與哲學對話，重視音樂並培養了
ja: ゴットフリート・ヴィルヘルム・ライプニッツのような学者と密接に交流し、哲学的な対話に参加し、音楽を重んじ、
local: Gottfried Wilhelm Leibniz, engaged in philosophical conversations, valued music and cultivated
ja_pron: Gottofurīto Viruherumu Raipunittsu no yō na gakusha to missetsu ni kōryū shi, tetsugakuteki na taiwa ni sanka shi, ongaku o omonjite,
native: Gottfried Wilhelm Leibniz, engaged in philosophical conversations, valued music and cultivated

en: an intellectual circle.
zh: 一個知識分子圈子。
ja: 知的なサークルを育んでいました。
local: an intellectual circle.
ja_pron: Chiteki na sākuru o hagukunde imashita.
native: an intellectual circle.

en: In her memory, Friedrich the First Commissioned, there are some residents, Leadsenberg,
zh: 為了紀念她，弗里德里希一世委託將萊察堡的一些居民，
ja: 彼女の記憶のために、フリードリヒ1世はライツェンベルクの住民に委託しました。
local: In her memory, Friedrich the First Commissioned, there are some residents, Leadsenberg,
ja_pron: Kanojo no kioku no tame ni, Furīdorihi Issei wa Raitsenberuku no jūmin ni itaku shimashita.
native: In her memory, Friedrich the First Commissioned, there are some residents, Leadsenberg,

en: to be renamed Schloss Charlotteenberg, a meaningful tribute to ensure her name and spirit
zh: 將其更名為夏洛特堡，這是一個有意義的致敬，以確保她的名字和精神
ja: それをシャルロッテンベルク城に改名することは、彼女の名前と精神を確実に残すための意味のある賛辞です。
local: to be renamed Schloss Charlotteenberg, a meaningful tribute to ensure her name and spirit
ja_pron: Sore o Sharurottenberuku-jō ni kaimei suru koto wa, kanojo no namae to seishin o kakujitsu ni nokosu tame no imi no aru sanji desu.
native: to be renamed Schloss Charlotteenberg, a meaningful tribute to ensure her name and spirit

en: would endure well beyond her passing.
zh: 能夠在她去世後長久流傳。
ja: 彼女の死後も長く続くことを保証します。
local: would endure well beyond her passing.
ja_pron: Kanojo no shigo mo nagaku tsuzuku koto o hoshō shimasu.
native: would endure well beyond her passing.

en: Sophie Charlotte was an accomplished Schambalo player.
zh: 索菲·夏洛特是一位出色的香巴洛球手。
ja: ゾフィー・シャルロッテは熟練したシャンバロの演奏者でした。
local: Sophie Charlotte was an accomplished Schambalo player.
ja_pron: Zofī Sharurotte wa jukuren shita Shanbaro no ensōsha deshita.
native: Sophie Charlotte was an accomplished Schambalo player.

en: Her talent was greatly admired and not just because one wanted to pay respect to the
zh: 她的才華備受讚賞，不僅僅是因為人們想向
ja: 彼女の才能は大いに称賛されましたが、それは単に敬意を表したいからだけではありませんでした。
local: Her talent was greatly admired and not just because one wanted to pay respect to the
ja_pron: Kanojo no sainō wa ōi ni shōsan saremashita ga, sore wa tan ni keii o hyōshitai kara dake de wa arimasen deshita.
native: Her talent was greatly admired and not just because one wanted to pay respect to the

en: regent.
zh: 攝政王。
ja: 摂政に対してだけではありません。
local: regent.
ja_pron: Sesshō ni taishite dake de wa arimasen.
native: regent.

en: In her possession was several Schambali among them the one that is currently on display
zh: 她擁有幾個香巴洛球，其中之一目前正在展出，
ja: 彼女は数個のシャンバロを所有しており、その中には現在展示されているものもあります。
local: In her possession was several Schambali among them the one that is currently on display
ja_pron: Kanojo wa sūko no Shanbaro o shoyū shite ori, sono naka ni wa genzai tenji sarete iru mono mo arimasu.
native: In her possession was several Schambali among them the one that is currently on display

en: here.
zh: 在這裡。
ja: ここにあります。
local: here.
ja_pron: Koko ni arimasu.
native: here.

en: It is painted white and with its vibrant decoration in the Chinese style serves as a testament
zh: 它被漆成白色，並以充滿活力的中國風裝飾作為證明，
ja: それは白く塗られており、中国風の鮮やかな装飾が施されていて、証となっています。
local: It is painted white and with its vibrant decoration in the Chinese style serves as a testament
ja_pron: Sore wa shiroku nurarete ori, Chūgoku-fū no azayaka na sōshoku ga hodokosarete ite, akashi to natte imasu.
native: It is painted white and with its vibrant decoration in the Chinese style serves as a testament

en: to Sophie Charlotte's deep passion for the China craze.
zh: 證明了索菲·夏洛特對中國熱潮的深厚熱情。
ja: ゾフィー・シャルロッテの中国趣味への深い情熱の証です。
local: to Sophie Charlotte's deep passion for the China craze.
ja_pron: Zofī Sharurotte no Chūgoku shumi e no fukai jōnetsu no akashi desu.
native: to Sophie Charlotte's deep passion for the China craze.

en: The queen loved beautiful things.
zh: 女王喜愛美麗的事物。
ja: 女王は美しいものを愛していました。
local: The queen loved beautiful things.
ja_pron: Joō wa utsukushii mono o aishite imashita.
native: The queen loved beautiful things.

en: Shortly after moving into Leadsenberg, Sophie Charlotte conceived the idea of adding
zh: 搬進萊察堡後不久，索菲·夏洛特產生了增建
ja: ライツェンベルクに引っ越して間もなく、ゾフィー・シャルロッテは追加するという考えを思いつきました。
local: Shortly after moving into Leadsenberg, Sophie Charlotte conceived the idea of adding
ja_pron: Raitsenberuku ni hikkoshite manonaku, Zofī Sharurotte wa tsuika suru to iu kangae o omoitsukimashita.
native: Shortly after moving into Leadsenberg, Sophie Charlotte conceived the idea of adding

en: a theatre to the castle.
zh: 一座劇院到城堡。
ja: 城に劇場を増設することを考えました。
local: a theatre to the castle.
ja_pron: Shiro ni gekijō o zōsetsu suru koto o kangaemashita.
native: a theatre to the castle.

en: In June 1700, it was inaugurated.
zh: 1700年6月，它正式啟用。
ja: 1700年6月に開館しました。
local: In June 1700, it was inaugurated.
ja_pron: 1700-nen 6-gatsu ni kaikan shimashita.
native: In June 1700, it was inaugurated.

en: From then on, Sophie Charlotte devoted all her efforts to inviting the finest composers.
zh: 從那時起，索菲·夏洛特全力邀請最優秀的作曲家。
ja: それ以来、ゾフィー・シャルロッテは最高の作曲家を招くことに全力を注ぎました。
local: From then on, Sophie Charlotte devoted all her efforts to inviting the finest composers.
ja_pron: Sore irai, Zofī Sharurotte wa saikō no sakkyokuka o maneku koto ni zenryoku o sosogimashita.
native: From then on, Sophie Charlotte devoted all her efforts to inviting the finest composers.

en: The Italian Atilio Arrosti brought her great joy and Giovanni Bonancini were honored guests
zh: 義大利人阿蒂利奧·阿羅斯蒂給她帶來了極大的喜悅，喬瓦尼·博南奇尼是受尊敬的嘉賓，
ja: イタリアのアティリオ・アロスティは彼女に大きな喜びをもたらし、ジョヴァンニ・ボナンチーニは名誉ある客人でした。
local: The Italian Atilio Arrosti brought her great joy and Giovanni Bonancini were honored guests
ja_pron: Itaria no Atirio Arosuti wa kanojo ni ōkina yorokobi o motarashi, Jovani Bonanchīni wa meiyo aru kyakujin deshita.
native: The Italian Atilio Arrosti brought her great joy and Giovanni Bonancini were honored guests

en: at her court of the Musas.
zh: 在她的繆斯宮廷。
ja: 彼女のミューズの宮廷で。
local: at her court of the Musas.
ja_pron: Kanojo no Myūzu no kyūtei de.
native: at her court of the Musas.

en: They organised concerts, composed music and staged operas where the ladies and gentlemen
zh: 他們組織音樂會，作曲並上演歌劇，宮廷的男女紳士們
ja: 彼らはコンサートを企画し、音楽を作曲し、宮廷の紳士淑女が出演するオペラを上演しました。
local: They organised concerts, composed music and staged operas where the ladies and gentlemen
ja_pron: Karera wa konsāto o kikaku shi, ongaku o sakkyoku shi, kyūtei no shinshi shukujo ga shutsuen suru opera o jōen shimashita.
native: They organised concerts, composed music and staged operas where the ladies and gentlemen

en: of the court took on pivotal roles.
zh: 扮演了重要角色。
ja: 宮廷の紳士淑女が重要な役割を果たしました。
local: of the court took on pivotal roles.
ja_pron: Kyūtei no shinshi shukujo ga jūyō na yakuwari o hatashimashita.
native: of the court took on pivotal roles.

en: Sophie Charlotte once even succeeded in winning over her young son Friedrich Wilhelm
zh: 索菲·夏洛特甚至曾成功贏得她年幼的兒子弗里德里希·威廉的支持，
ja: ゾフィー・シャルロッテは若い息子フリードリヒ・ヴィルヘルムの心を掴むことにも成功しました。
local: Sophie Charlotte once even succeeded in winning over her young son Friedrich Wilhelm
ja_pron: Zofī Sharurotte wa wakai musuko Furīdorihi Viruherumu no kokoro o tsukamu koto ni mo seikō shimashita.
native: Sophie Charlotte once even succeeded in winning over her young son Friedrich Wilhelm

en: to her cause.
zh: 為了她的事業。
ja: 彼女の大義のために。
local: to her cause.
ja_pron: Kanojo no taigi no tame ni.
native: to her cause.

en: He appeared as Cupid, the Roman god of love, even though the future soldier king even
zh: 他扮成丘比特，羅馬的愛神，儘管未來的軍人國王甚至
ja: 彼はローマの愛の神キューピッドとして現れましたが、将来の軍人王でさえも
local: He appeared as Cupid, the Roman god of love, even though the future soldier king even
ja_pron: Kare wa Rōma no ai no kami Kyūpiddo to shite arawaremashita ga, shōrai no gunjin ō de sae mo
native: He appeared as Cupid, the Roman god of love, even though the future soldier king even

en: in those early days was completely horrified by the idea of courtly entertainment.
zh: 在那些早期日子裡，完全害怕宮廷娛樂的想法。
ja: その初期の頃には、宮廷の娯楽の考えに完全に恐怖していました。
local: in those early days was completely horrified by the idea of courtly entertainment.
ja_pron: Sono shoki no koro ni wa, kyūtei no goraku no kangae ni kanzen ni kyōfu shite imashita.
native: in those early days was completely horrified by the idea of courtly entertainment.

en: Sophie Charlotte's passion inherited itself only again in her grandson, Frederick the
zh: 索菲·夏洛特的熱情只在她的孫子弗雷德里克身上再次繼承。
ja: ゾフィー・シャルロッテの情熱は、彼女の孫であるフリードリヒにのみ再び受け継がれました。
local: Sophie Charlotte's passion inherited itself only again in her grandson, Frederick the
ja_pron: Zofī Sharurotte no jōnetsu wa, kanojo no mago de aru Furīdorihi ni nomi futatabi uketsugaremashita.
native: Sophie Charlotte's passion inherited itself only again in her grandson, Frederick the

en: Great.
zh: 偉大者。
ja: 大王に。
local: Great.
ja_pron: Daiō ni.
native: Great.

en: It was he who also had the room adorned with the tapestries.
zh: 也是他讓這個房間裝飾上了掛毯。
ja: 彼こそがこの部屋をタペストリーで飾らせたのです。
local: It was he who also had the room adorned with the tapestries.
ja_pron: Kare koso ga kono heya o tapesutorī de kazaraseta no desu.
native: It was he who also had the room adorned with the tapestries.

en: During Sophie Charlotte's lifetime, the room served as an anti-chamber to the actual audience
zh: 在索菲·夏洛特生前，這個房間作為正式會客廳的前廳。
ja: ゾフィー・シャルロッテの生涯の間、この部屋は正式な謁見室の前室として使われていました。
local: During Sophie Charlotte's lifetime, the room served as an anti-chamber to the actual audience
ja_pron: Zofī Sharurotte no shōgai no aida, kono heya wa seishiki na ekken-shitsu no zenshitsu to shite tsukawarete imashita.
native: During Sophie Charlotte's lifetime, the room served as an anti-chamber to the actual audience

en: hall.
zh: 大廳。
ja: ホール。
local: hall.
ja_pron: Hōru.
native: hall.

en: When Sophie Charlotte's guests entered the palace through the grand oval hall and waited
zh: 當索菲·夏洛特的客人通過宏偉的橢圓形大廳並等待時，
ja: ゾフィー・シャルロッテの客人が壮大な楕円形のホールを通って宮殿に入り、待っていると、
local: When Sophie Charlotte's guests entered the palace through the grand oval hall and waited
ja_pron: Zofī Sharurotte no kyakujin ga sōdaina daenkei no hōru o tōtte kyūden ni hairi, matte iru to,
native: When Sophie Charlotte's guests entered the palace through the grand oval hall and waited

en: for a while in the anti-chamber, they would then be formally received by the Queen
zh: 在前廳稍作等待後，他們會被女王正式接見，
ja: 前室でしばらく待った後、彼らは女王によって正式に迎えられました。
local: for a while in the anti-chamber, they would then be formally received by the Queen
ja_pron: Zenshitsu de shibaraku matta ato, karera wa joō ni yotte seishiki ni mukaeraremashita.
native: for a while in the anti-chamber, they would then be formally received by the Queen

en: herself in the beautifully adorned audience chamber here.
zh: 親自在這個裝飾華麗的會客廳接見。
ja: ここで美しく飾られた謁見室で直接会いました。
local: herself in the beautifully adorned audience chamber here.
ja_pron: Koko de utsukushiku kazarareta ekkenshitsu de chokusetsu aimashita.
native: herself in the beautifully adorned audience chamber here.

en: Although they did not see Sophie Charlotte in front of these tapestries, depicting scenes
zh: 雖然他們沒有看到索菲·夏洛特站在這些描繪場景的掛毯前，
ja: 彼らはこれらの場面を描いたタペストリーの前でゾフィー・シャルロッテを見ることはありませんでしたが、
local: Although they did not see Sophie Charlotte in front of these tapestries, depicting scenes
ja_pron: Karera wa korera no bamen o kaita tapesutorī no mae de Zofī Sharurotte o miru koto wa arimasen deshita ga,
native: Although they did not see Sophie Charlotte in front of these tapestries, depicting scenes

en: from the Italian Commedia de la Tae, these were commissioned later by Frederick the Great.
zh: 這些掛毯描繪的是意大利喜劇場景，後來由偉大的弗雷德里克委託製作。
ja: これらはイタリアのコメディア・デ・ラ・テを描いており、後にフリードリヒ大王によって依頼されました。
local: from the Italian Commedia de la Tae, these were commissioned later by Frederick the Great.
ja_pron: Korera wa Itaria no Komedia de la Tae o egaite ori, nochi ni Furīdorihi Daiō ni yotte irai saremashita.
native: from the Italian Commedia de la Tae, these were commissioned later by Frederick the Great.

en: But in front of a fine wallpaper adorned with Chinese motifs.
zh: 但他們面前的是裝飾有中國圖案的精美牆紙。
ja: しかし、彼らの前には中国のモチーフで飾られた美しい壁紙がありました。
local: But in front of a fine wallpaper adorned with Chinese motifs.
ja_pron: Shikashi, karera no mae ni wa Chūgoku no mochīfu de kazarareta utsukushii kabegami ga arimashita.
native: But in front of a fine wallpaper adorned with Chinese motifs.

en: The furnishings of the room were strikingly similar to today's, notably the small table
zh: 這個房間的家具與今天的非常相似，尤其是那張小桌子，
ja: この部屋の家具は今日のものと非常によく似ており、特に小さなテーブルがそうです。
local: The furnishings of the room were strikingly similar to today's, notably the small table
ja_pron: Kono heya no kagu wa kyō no mono to hijō ni yoku nite ori, toku ni chiisana tēburu ga sō desu.
native: The furnishings of the room were strikingly similar to today's, notably the small table

en: with the two geradons or candle holder stands remains original.
zh: 帶有兩個燭台架的仍是原件。
ja: 2つのジェラドン、つまり燭台スタンドが付いた小さなテーブルは元のままです。
local: with the two geradons or candle holder stands remains original.
ja_pron: Futatsu no Jeradon, tsumari shokudai sutando ga tsuita chiisana tēburu wa moto no mama desu.
native: with the two geradons or candle holder stands remains original.

en: Small putis seem to firmly uphold the tabletop.
zh: 小天使雕像似乎牢牢支撐著桌面。
ja: 小さなプティがしっかりと天板を支えているようです。
local: Small putis seem to firmly uphold the tabletop.
ja_pron: Chīsana puti ga shikkari to tenban o sasaete iru yō desu.
native: Small putis seem to firmly uphold the tabletop.

en: They are intricately carved from wood, coated and painted white to precisely mimic porcelain.
zh: 它們由木頭精雕細琢，塗層並漆成白色，精確模仿瓷器。
ja: それらは木から精巧に彫刻され、白く塗装されて磁器を正確に模倣しています。
local: They are intricately carved from wood, coated and painted white to precisely mimic porcelain.
ja_pron: Sorera wa ki kara seikō ni chōkoku sare, shiroku tosō sarete jiki o seikaku ni mohō shite imasu.
native: They are intricately carved from wood, coated and painted white to precisely mimic porcelain.

en: The golden acanthus leaves can be found again on the gilded section of the ceiling.
zh: 金色的刺葉植物圖案再次出現在天花板的鍍金部分。
ja: 金色のアカンサスの葉は天井の金箔部分にも見られます。
local: The golden acanthus leaves can be found again on the gilded section of the ceiling.
ja_pron: Kin'iro no akansasu no ha wa tenjō no kinpaku bubun ni mo mirareru.
native: The golden acanthus leaves can be found again on the gilded section of the ceiling.

en: A clear indication that the furniture was meant for this room, the geradons were used
zh: 這清楚表明這些家具是為這個房間準備的，燭台被用來
ja: 家具がこの部屋のためのものである明確な証拠であり、ジェラドンは使用されました
local: A clear indication that the furniture was meant for this room, the geradons were used
ja_pron: Kagu ga kono heya no tame no mono de aru meikaku na shōko de ari, Jeradon wa shiyō saremashita
native: A clear indication that the furniture was meant for this room, the geradons were used

en: to light up the space.
zh: 照亮這個空間。
ja: 空間を照らすために。
local: to light up the space.
ja_pron: Kūkan o terasu tame ni.
native: to light up the space.

en: Shander leers like the magnificent one hung here, with glass crystals in the shape of pearls,
zh: 像這裡掛著的華麗吊燈，帶有珍珠形狀的玻璃水晶，
ja: ここに掛けられている壮麗なシャンデリアのように、真珠の形をしたガラスのクリスタルが付いています。
local: Shander leers like the magnificent one hung here, with glass crystals in the shape of pearls,
ja_pron: Koko ni kakerarete iru sōrei na shanderia no yō ni, shinju no katachi o shita garasu no kurisutaru ga tsuite imasu.
native: Shander leers like the magnificent one hung here, with glass crystals in the shape of pearls,

en: did not yet exist in Leatsenberg Palace during Sophie Charlotte's time.
zh: 在索菲·夏洛特時代，萊岑堡宮還不存在這樣的吊燈。
ja: ゾフィー・シャルロッテの時代のライツェンベルク宮殿にはまだ存在していませんでした。
local: did not yet exist in Leatsenberg Palace during Sophie Charlotte's time.
ja_pron: Zofī Sharurotte no jidai no Raizenberuku kyūden ni wa mada sonzai shite imasen deshita.
native: did not yet exist in Leatsenberg Palace during Sophie Charlotte's time.

en: The fire in the fireplace would have offered a pleasant warm glow throughout the evening
zh: 壁爐中的火焰在整個晚上會提供宜人的溫暖光芒，
ja: 暖炉の火は夜通し心地よい暖かい輝きを提供していたでしょう。
local: The fire in the fireplace would have offered a pleasant warm glow throughout the evening
ja_pron: Danro no hi wa yoru dōshi kokochiyoi atatakai kagayaki o teikyō shite ita deshō.
native: The fire in the fireplace would have offered a pleasant warm glow throughout the evening

en: hours.
zh: 時光。
ja: 時間。
local: hours.
ja_pron: Jikan.
native: hours.

en: Above the actual fireplace hung not a painting or mirror, but a relief, which was encircled
zh: 在真正的壁爐上方懸掛的不是畫作或鏡子，而是一個浮雕，周圍環繞著
ja: 実際の暖炉の上には絵画や鏡ではなく、レリーフが掛けられており、その周りには
local: Above the actual fireplace hung not a painting or mirror, but a relief, which was encircled
ja_pron: Jissai no danro no ue ni wa kaiga ya kagami de wa naku, rerīfu ga kakerarete ori, sono mawari ni wa
native: Above the actual fireplace hung not a painting or mirror, but a relief, which was encircled

en: by a whole row of small consoles where Sophie Charlotte lovingly displayed her cherished
zh: 一整排小型展示架，索菲·夏洛特在那裡溫柔地展示她珍愛的
ja: 小さなコンソールが一列に並び、ゾフィー・シャルロッテが大切にしていた
local: by a whole row of small consoles where Sophie Charlotte lovingly displayed her cherished
ja_pron: Chīsana konsōru ga ichiretsu ni narabi, Zofī Sharurotte ga taisetsu ni shite ita
native: by a whole row of small consoles where Sophie Charlotte lovingly displayed her cherished

en: porcelain collection.
zh: 瓷器收藏。
ja: 磁器のコレクションを愛情を込めて展示していました。
local: porcelain collection.
ja_pron: Jiki no korekushon o aijō o komete tenji shite imashita.
native: porcelain collection.

en: The ceiling of the audience chamber is significantly higher than in the two preceding rooms.
zh: 會客廳的天花板比前兩個房間明顯更高。
ja: 謁見室の天井は、前の2つの部屋よりもかなり高くなっています。
local: The ceiling of the audience chamber is significantly higher than in the two preceding rooms.
ja_pron: Ekkenshitsu no tenjō wa, mae no futatsu no heya yori mo kanari takaku natte imasu.
native: The ceiling of the audience chamber is significantly higher than in the two preceding rooms.

en: It is positioned within the extension that Sophie Charlotte and her husband commissioned
zh: 它位於索菲·夏洛特和她丈夫委託擴建的部分，
ja: それはゾフィー・シャルロッテと彼女の夫が依頼した増築部分に位置しています。
local: It is positioned within the extension that Sophie Charlotte and her husband commissioned
ja_pron: Sore wa Zofī Sharurotte to kanojo no otto ga irai shita zōchiku bubun ni ichi shite imasu.
native: It is positioned within the extension that Sophie Charlotte and her husband commissioned

en: to be added to the old palace after 1702.
zh: 於1702年後加建到舊宮殿。
ja: 1702年以降に古い宮殿に追加されました。
local: to be added to the old palace after 1702.
ja_pron: 1702-nen ikō ni furui kyūden ni tsuika saremashita.
native: to be added to the old palace after 1702.

en: In 1701, Frederick, Elector of Brandenburg, crowned himself as the first king in Prussia,
zh: 1701年，布蘭登堡選帝侯弗雷德里克自封為普魯士的第一位國王，
ja: 1701年、ブランデンブルク選帝侯フリードリヒはプロイセンで初めて自らを王と宣言しました。
local: In 1701, Frederick, Elector of Brandenburg, crowned himself as the first king in Prussia,
ja_pron: 1701-nen, Burandenburuku sentekikō Furīdorihi wa Puroisen de hajimete mizukara o ō to sengen shimashita.
native: In 1701, Frederick, Elector of Brandenburg, crowned himself as the first king in Prussia,

en: a pivotal and transformative event in the region's history.
zh: 這是該地區歷史上一個關鍵且具有變革性的事件。
ja: これは地域の歴史における重要で変革的な出来事でした。
local: a pivotal and transformative event in the region's history.
ja_pron: Kore wa chiiki no rekishi ni okeru jūyō de henkakuteki na dekigoto deshita.
native: a pivotal and transformative event in the region's history.

en: One should be able to see this rise in power politics in the palaces as well.
zh: 人們也應該能在宮殿中看到這種權力政治的崛起。
ja: この権力政治の台頭は宮殿にも見て取れるはずです。
local: One should be able to see this rise in power politics in the palaces as well.
ja_pron: Kono kenryoku seiji no taitō wa kyūden ni mo mite toreru hazu desu.
native: One should be able to see this rise in power politics in the palaces as well.

en: Everywhere they were building, expanding and embellishing.
zh: 他們到處建造、擴建和裝飾。
ja: 彼らはあらゆる場所で建設、拡張、装飾を行っていました。
local: Everywhere they were building, expanding and embellishing.
ja_pron: Karera wa arayuru basho de kensetsu, kakuchō, sōshoku o okonatte imashita.
native: Everywhere they were building, expanding and embellishing.

en: In Charlotte and Berg, a grand parade apartment was constructed, though it wasn't finished
zh: 在夏洛特和伯格，建造了一座宏偉的遊行公寓，儘管尚未完成，
ja: シャルロッテとベルクでは壮大なパレードアパートメントが建設されましたが、完成はしていませんでした。
local: In Charlotte and Berg, a grand parade apartment was constructed, though it wasn't finished
ja_pron: Sharurotte to Beruku de wa sōdaina parēdo apātomento ga kensetsu saremashita ga, kansei wa shite imasen deshita.
native: In Charlotte and Berg, a grand parade apartment was constructed, though it wasn't finished

en: until just after Sophie Charlotte's passing.
zh: 直到索菲·夏洛特去世後不久才完成。
ja: ゾフィー・シャルロッテの死後まもなく完成しました。
local: until just after Sophie Charlotte's passing.
ja_pron: Zofī Sharurotte no shigo manaku kansei shimashita.
native: until just after Sophie Charlotte's passing.

en: It spans a total of seven spacious rooms.
zh: 它總共包含七個寬敞的房間。
ja: それは合計で7つの広々とした部屋にまたがっています。
local: It spans a total of seven spacious rooms.
ja_pron: Sore wa gōkei de nanatsu no hirobiro to shita heya ni matagatte imasu.
native: It spans a total of seven spacious rooms.

en: The magnificent audience chamber stands as the first highlight of this grand parade apartment.
zh: 宏偉的會客廳是這座宏大遊行公寓的第一個亮點。
ja: 壮大な謁見室はこの壮麗なパレードアパートメントの最初の見どころです。
local: The magnificent audience chamber stands as the first highlight of this grand parade apartment.
ja_pron: Sōdaina ekkenshitsu wa kono sōrei na parēdo apātomento no saisho no midokoro desu.
native: The magnificent audience chamber stands as the first highlight of this grand parade apartment.

en: Here the king received important state guests.
zh: 國王在此接待重要的國家賓客。
ja: ここで王は重要な国家の客人を迎えました。
local: Here the king received important state guests.
ja_pron: Koko de ō wa jūyō na kokka no kyakujin o mukaemashita.
native: Here the king received important state guests.

en: The rank of the guest determined whether Frederick I granted the audience standing or seated.
zh: 賓客的等級決定了弗雷德里克一世是否允許站立或坐著會見。
ja: 客の階級によって、フリードリヒ1世が立っての謁見か座っての謁見かを決めました。
local: The rank of the guest determined whether Frederick I granted the audience standing or seated.
ja_pron: Kyaku no kaikyū ni yotte, Furīdorihi 1-sei ga tatte no ekken ka suwatte no ekken ka o kimemashita.
native: The rank of the guest determined whether Frederick I granted the audience standing or seated.

en: If the guest was invited to sit, they were provided with a seat, carefully tailored to
zh: 如果賓客被邀請坐下，會提供一個根據
ja: もし客が座るよう招かれた場合、彼らには慎重に調整された席が提供されました。
local: If the guest was invited to sit, they were provided with a seat, carefully tailored to
ja_pron: Moshi kyaku ga suwaru yō manekareta baai, karera ni wa shinchō ni chōsei sareta seki ga teikyō saremashita.
native: If the guest was invited to sit, they were provided with a seat, carefully tailored to

en: their rank, which could include armrests and cushions or lack them entirely.
zh: 他們的等級，可能包括扶手和靠墊，或者完全沒有。
ja: 彼らの階級に合わせて、肘掛けやクッションが付くこともあれば、全くないこともありました。
local: their rank, which could include armrests and cushions or lack them entirely.
ja_pron: Karera no kaikyū ni awasete, hijikake ya kusshon ga tsuku koto mo areba, mattaku nai koto mo arimashita.
native: their rank, which could include armrests and cushions or lack them entirely.

en: In all European palaces, audience chambers were lavishly furnished with exceptionally
zh: 在所有歐洲宮殿中，會客廳都裝飾得非常奢華，配備了極其
ja: すべてのヨーロッパの宮殿で、謁見室は非常に豪華に装飾されていました。
local: In all European palaces, audience chambers were lavishly furnished with exceptionally
ja_pron: Subete no Yōroppa no kyūden de, ekkenshitsu wa hijō ni gōka ni sōshoku sarete imashita.
native: In all European palaces, audience chambers were lavishly furnished with exceptionally

en: precious and impressive items, such as marble clad walls and elaborate tapestries, adorning
zh: 珍貴且令人印象深刻的物品，如大理石覆蓋的牆壁和精緻的掛毯，裝飾著
ja: 大理石張りの壁や精巧なタペストリーなど、貴重で印象的な品々で飾られていました。
local: precious and impressive items, such as marble clad walls and elaborate tapestries, adorning
ja_pron: Dairiseki bari no kabe ya seikō na tapesutorī nado, kichō de inshō-teki na shinagaki de kazararete imashita.
native: precious and impressive items, such as marble clad walls and elaborate tapestries, adorning

en: the grand spaces.
zh: 這些宏偉的空間。
ja: 壮大な空間を。
local: the grand spaces.
ja_pron: Sōdaina kūkan o.
native: the grand spaces.

en: In that period, their value significantly outweighed the price of an individual painting.
zh: 在那個時期，它們的價值遠遠超過單幅畫作的價格。
ja: その時代、それらの価値は個々の絵画の価格を大きく上回っていました。
local: In that period, their value significantly outweighed the price of an individual painting.
ja_pron: Sono jidai, sorera no kachi wa koko no kaiga no kakaku o ōkiku uwamawatte imashita.
native: In that period, their value significantly outweighed the price of an individual painting.

en: The tapestries in this room vividly portray various scenes from the lives of renowned Greeks
zh: 這個房間的掛毯生動描繪了著名希臘人生活中的各種場景，
ja: この部屋のタペストリーは、有名なギリシャ人の生活の様々な場面を鮮やかに描いています。
local: The tapestries in this room vividly portray various scenes from the lives of renowned Greeks
ja_pron: Kono heya no tapesutorī wa, yūmei na Girishajin no seikatsu no samazama na bamen o azayaka ni egaite imasu.
native: The tapestries in this room vividly portray various scenes from the lives of renowned Greeks

en: and Romans, as meticulously recorded by the ancient historian Plutarch.
zh: 和羅馬人，正如古代歷史學家普魯塔克詳細記錄的那樣。
ja: そしてローマ人の生活も、古代の歴史家プルタルコスによって綿密に記録されています。
local: and Romans, as meticulously recorded by the ancient historian Plutarch.
ja_pron: Soshite Rōmajin no seikatsu mo, kodai no rekishika Purutarukosu ni yotte menmitsu ni kiroku sarete imasu.
native: and Romans, as meticulously recorded by the ancient historian Plutarch.

en: By choosing this theme, the Lord of the House consciously aligned himself with the role models
zh: 通過選擇這個主題，宅主有意識地將自己與榜樣對齊，
ja: このテーマを選ぶことで、家の主は意識的に模範となる人物と自分を重ね合わせました。
local: By choosing this theme, the Lord of the House consciously aligned himself with the role models
ja_pron: Kono tēma o erabu koto de, ie no nushi wa ishiki-teki ni mohan to naru jinbutsu to jibun o kasaneawasemashita.
native: By choosing this theme, the Lord of the House consciously aligned himself with the role models

en: of classical antiquity.
zh: 古典古代的榜樣。
ja: 古典古代の模範者たちに。
local: of classical antiquity.
ja_pron: Koten kodai no mohan-sha-tachi ni.
native: of classical antiquity.

en: The red damask chamber is what this gallery-like room is called.
zh: 這個像畫廊一樣的房間被稱為紅色緞面室。
ja: このギャラリーのような部屋は赤いダマスク室と呼ばれています。
local: The red damask chamber is what this gallery-like room is called.
ja_pron: Kono gyararī no yō na heya wa akai damasuku shitsu to yobarete imasu.
native: The red damask chamber is what this gallery-like room is called.

en: The walls are covered with a red damask wallpaper and richly adorned with golden braids,
zh: 牆壁覆蓋著紅色緞面牆紙，並富麗堂皇地裝飾著金色織帶，
ja: 壁は赤いダマスクの壁紙で覆われ、金色の編み紐で豊かに飾られています。
local: The walls are covered with a red damask wallpaper and richly adorned with golden braids,
ja_pron: Kabe wa akai damasuku no kabegami de ōware, kin'iro no amihimo de yutaka ni kazararete imasu.
native: The walls are covered with a red damask wallpaper and richly adorned with golden braids,

en: that is, trims made of woven metal threads.
zh: 也就是由織成的金屬線製成的飾邊。
ja: つまり、織られた金属糸で作られた縁飾りです。
local: that is, trims made of woven metal threads.
ja_pron: Tsumari, orareta kinzoku ito de tsukurareta fuchikazari desu.
native: that is, trims made of woven metal threads.

en: Above the doors, portraits depict the ruling couple, King Frederick I and directly across
zh: 門上方，肖像描繪了統治夫婦，弗雷德里克一世國王和正對面的
ja: 扉の上には、統治者の夫妻、フリードリヒ1世王とその正面にいる
local: Above the doors, portraits depict the ruling couple, King Frederick I and directly across
ja_pron: Tobira no ue ni wa, tōchisha no fusai, Furīdorihi 1-sei ō to sono shōmen ni iru
native: Above the doors, portraits depict the ruling couple, King Frederick I and directly across

en: from him Queen Sophie Charlotte.
zh: 他對面的索菲·夏洛特女王。
ja: 彼の向かい側にいるゾフィー・シャルロッテ女王が描かれています。
local: from him Queen Sophie Charlotte.
ja_pron: Kare no mukai-gawa ni iru Zofī Sharurotte joō ga egakarete imasu.
native: from him Queen Sophie Charlotte.

en: The two are also represented through distinct elements taken from their respective coats
zh: 兩人也通過各自紋章中的不同元素來表現，
ja: 二人はそれぞれの紋章から取られた異なる要素でも表現されています。
local: The two are also represented through distinct elements taken from their respective coats
ja_pron: Futari wa sorezore no monshō kara torareta kotonaru yōso demo hyōgen sarete imasu.
native: The two are also represented through distinct elements taken from their respective coats

en: of arms.
zh: 的紋章。
ja: の紋章です。
local: of arms.
ja_pron: No monshō desu.
native: of arms.

en: Thus, the crown and the eagle of Prussia, along with the leaping horse of the house of Hanover,
zh: 因此，普魯士的王冠和鷹，以及漢諾威家的跳躍馬，
ja: したがって、プロイセンの王冠と鷲、そしてハノーファー家の跳ね馬が、
local: Thus, the crown and the eagle of Prussia, along with the leaping horse of the house of Hanover,
ja_pron: Shitagatte, Puroisen no ōkan to washi, soshite Hanōfā-ke no hanema ga,
native: Thus, the crown and the eagle of Prussia, along with the leaping horse of the house of Hanover,

en: are depicted in the decorative frees encircling the ceiling.
zh: 被描繪在環繞天花板的裝飾浮雕中。
ja: 天井を囲む装飾的なフリーズに描かれています。
local: are depicted in the decorative frees encircling the ceiling.
ja_pron: Tenjō o kakomu sōshokuteki na furīzu ni egakarete imasu.
native: are depicted in the decorative frees encircling the ceiling.

en: The room would have looked even more impressive and representative had a specific plan
zh: 如果有一個特定的計劃成功實施，這個房間會看起來更加令人印象深刻和具代表性。
ja: 特定の計画が成功していれば、この部屋はさらに印象的で代表的に見えたでしょう。
local: The room would have looked even more impressive and representative had a specific plan
ja_pron: Tokutei no keikaku ga seikō shite ireba, kono heya wa sara ni inshō-teki de daihyō-teki ni mieta deshō.
native: The room would have looked even more impressive and representative had a specific plan

en: been carried out successfully.
zh: 被成功執行。
ja: 成功裏に実行されたでしょう。
local: been carried out successfully.
ja_pron: Seikōri ni jikkō sareta deshō.
native: been carried out successfully.

en: As this gallery was originally designed to serve as the home for the legendary amber
zh: 因為這個畫廊最初被設計為傳奇琥珀室的所在地，
ja: このギャラリーはもともと伝説の琥珀の間のために設計されていました。
local: As this gallery was originally designed to serve as the home for the legendary amber
ja_pron: Kono gyararī wa motomoto densetsu no kohaku no ma no tame ni sekkei sarete imashita.
native: As this gallery was originally designed to serve as the home for the legendary amber

en: room itself.
zh: 琥珀室本身。
ja: 部屋そのものです。
local: room itself.
ja_pron: Heya sono mono desu.
native: room itself.

en: However, it was still incomplete when Charlotte and Burg Palace became the setting for an
zh: 然而，當夏洛特和伯格宮成為一個場合時，它仍未完成，
ja: しかし、シャルロッテとベルク宮殿がある場の舞台となったとき、まだ未完成でした。
local: However, it was still incomplete when Charlotte and Burg Palace became the setting for an
ja_pron: Shikashi, Sharurotte to Beruku kyūden ga aru ba no butai to natta toki, mada mikansei deshita.
native: However, it was still incomplete when Charlotte and Burg Palace became the setting for an

en: extraordinary meeting in 1709.
zh: 1709年一場非凡的會議。
ja: 1709年の特別な会合でした。
local: extraordinary meeting in 1709.
ja_pron: 1709-nen no tokubetsu na kaigō deshita.
native: extraordinary meeting in 1709.

en: In that year, Friedrich the Fi hosted August the Strong of Saxony, who was simultaneously
zh: 那年，弗里德里希一世接待了同時擔任薩克森強王的奧古斯特，
ja: その年、フリードリヒ1世はザクセンの強力なオーガストを迎えました。
local: In that year, Friedrich the Fi hosted August the Strong of Saxony, who was simultaneously
ja_pron: Sono toshi, Furīdorihi 1-sei wa Zakusen no kyōryoku na Ōgasuto o mukaemashita.
native: In that year, Friedrich the Fi hosted August the Strong of Saxony, who was simultaneously

en: the King of Poland and the Danish King Friedrich the Fulf.
zh: 同時也是波蘭國王和丹麥國王弗雷德里希·富爾夫。
ja: 同時にポーランド王であり、デンマーク王フリードリヒ・フルフでもありました。
local: the King of Poland and the Danish King Friedrich the Fulf.
ja_pron: Dōji ni Pōrando ō de ari, Denmāku ō Furīdorihi Furufu demo arimashita.
native: the King of Poland and the Danish King Friedrich the Fulf.

en: The gathering of the monarchs would go down in history as the meeting of the three kings,
zh: 這次君主的聚會將被載入史冊，稱為三王會晤，
ja: 君主たちの集まりは三王会議として歴史に刻まれました。
local: The gathering of the monarchs would go down in history as the meeting of the three kings,
ja_pron: Kunshu-tachi no atsumari wa san-ō kaigi to shite rekishi ni kizamararemashita.
native: The gathering of the monarchs would go down in history as the meeting of the three kings,

en: a truly momentous and historic event.
zh: 一個真正重要且歷史性的事件。
ja: 真に重要で歴史的な出来事でした。
local: a truly momentous and historic event.
ja_pron: Shin ni jūyō de rekishiteki na dekigoto deshita.
native: a truly momentous and historic event.

en: For this purpose, even this still unfinished room had to be furnished in a truly representative
zh: 為此，即使是這個尚未完成的房間也必須以真正具代表性的方式布置，
ja: この目的のために、このまだ未完成の部屋でさえも真に代表的な形で家具が配置されなければなりませんでした。
local: For this purpose, even this still unfinished room had to be furnished in a truly representative
ja_pron: Kono mokuteki no tame ni, kono mada mikansei no heya de sae mo shin ni daihyō-teki na katachi de kagu ga haichi sarenakereba narimasen deshita.
native: For this purpose, even this still unfinished room had to be furnished in a truly representative

en: and dignified manner.
zh: 且莊重的方式。
ja: そして威厳のある方法で。
local: and dignified manner.
ja_pron: Soshite igen no aru hōhō de.
native: and dignified manner.

en: So they planned a redesign and adorned the walls, not with amber, but with red damask fabric
zh: 因此他們計劃重新設計，並用紅色緞面布料裝飾牆壁，而非琥珀，
ja: そこで彼らは再設計を計画し、壁を琥珀ではなく赤いダマスクの布で飾りました。
local: So they planned a redesign and adorned the walls, not with amber, but with red damask fabric
ja_pron: Soko de karera wa sai sekkei o keikaku shi, kabe o kohaku de wa naku akai damasuku no nuno de kazarimashita.
native: So they planned a redesign and adorned the walls, not with amber, but with red damask fabric

en: and gold brocade panels on the wall coverings.
zh: 以及牆面覆蓋的金色錦緞面板。
ja: そして壁の覆いには金のブロケードパネルを使いました。
local: and gold brocade panels on the wall coverings.
ja_pron: Soshite kabe no ōi ni wa kin no burokeedo paneru o tsukaimashita.
native: and gold brocade panels on the wall coverings.

en: In the private audience chamber, chosen visitors were summoned for exclusive private
zh: 在私人會客廳中，特選訪客被召喚進行專屬的私人會談，
ja: 私的な謁見室では、選ばれた訪問者が排他的な私的会談のために召喚されました。
local: In the private audience chamber, chosen visitors were summoned for exclusive private
ja_pron: Shiteki na ekkenshitsu de wa, erabareta hōmonsha ga haitateki na shiteki kaidan no tame ni shōkan saremashita.
native: In the private audience chamber, chosen visitors were summoned for exclusive private

en: audiences.
zh: 會見。
ja: 謁見。
local: audiences.
ja_pron: Ekkenshitsu.
native: audiences.

en: Such a conversation was notably more exclusive and intimate compared to the public audiences
zh: 這樣的對話相比於公開會見，明顯更為排他且親密，
ja: このような会話は、公の謁見と比べて著しく排他的で親密でした。
local: Such a conversation was notably more exclusive and intimate compared to the public audiences
ja_pron: Kono yō na kaiwa wa, ōyake no ekken to kurabete ichijirushiku haitateki de shinmitsudeshita.
native: Such a conversation was notably more exclusive and intimate compared to the public audiences

en: that were traditionally held in the grand and formal audience chamber.
zh: 這些公開會見傳統上在宏大且正式的會客廳舉行。
ja: これらの公の謁見は伝統的に壮大で正式な謁見室で行われました。
local: that were traditionally held in the grand and formal audience chamber.
ja_pron: Korera no ōyake no ekken wa dentō-teki ni sōdai de seishiki na ekkenshitsu de okonawaremashita.
native: that were traditionally held in the grand and formal audience chamber.

en: Even in these private settings, the ceremony couldn't be entirely dismissed, though visibly
zh: 即使在這些私人場合，儀式也無法完全被忽視，儘管明顯地
ja: これらの私的な場でも儀式は完全には無視できませんでしたが、明らかに
local: Even in these private settings, the ceremony couldn't be entirely dismissed, though visibly
ja_pron: Korera no shiteki na ba demo gishiki wa kanzen ni wa mushi dekimasen deshita ga, akiraka ni
native: Even in these private settings, the ceremony couldn't be entirely dismissed, though visibly

en: emphasising rank differences played a far less significant role in such meetings, yes.
zh: 強調等級差異在這種會議中扮演的角色要小得多，是的。
ja: 階級の違いを強調することは、そのような会合でははるかに重要な役割を果たしませんでした、はい。
local: emphasising rank differences played a far less significant role in such meetings, yes.
ja_pron: Kaikyū no chigai o kyōchō suru koto wa, sono yō na kaigō de wa haruka ni jūyō na yakuwari o hatashimasen deshita, hai.
native: emphasising rank differences played a far less significant role in such meetings, yes.

en: On occasion, the King would graciously offer his guest an armchair, one that mirrored his own exactly.
zh: 有時，國王會親切地為客人提供一把扶手椅，這把椅子與他自己的完全相同。
ja: 時折、王は客に自分と全く同じ肘掛け椅子を親切に差し出しました。
local: On occasion, the King would graciously offer his guest an armchair, one that mirrored his own exactly.
native: On occasion, the King would graciously offer his guest an armchair, one that mirrored his own exactly.

en: This gesture was intended to signal to the guest that a conversation on equal footing was taking place.
zh: 這個舉動旨在向客人表示雙方正在平等地交談。
ja: この行為は、対等な立場で会話が行われていることを客に示す意図がありました。
local: This gesture was intended to signal to the guest that a conversation on equal footing was taking place.
native: This gesture was intended to signal to the guest that a conversation on equal footing was taking place.

en: The ceiling is constructed from five large oil paintings that were created on canvas.
zh: 天花板由五幅大型油畫組成，這些油畫是畫在畫布上的。
ja: 天井はキャンバスに描かれた五つの大きな油絵で構成されています。
local: The ceiling is constructed from five large oil paintings that were created on canvas.
native: The ceiling is constructed from five large oil paintings that were created on canvas.

en: Depicted is the cycle of the year, embodied by the four seasons, the 12 zodiac signs, and the ancient mythological deities of the sun and the moon Apollo and Diana.
zh: 描繪的是一年循環，由四季、十二星座，以及古代神話中的太陽與月亮神阿波羅和戴安娜所象徵。
ja: 描かれているのは一年の循環で、四季、十二星座、そして太陽と月の古代神話の神アポロとディアナが具現化されています。
local: Depicted is the cycle of the year, embodied by the four seasons, the 12 zodiac signs, and the ancient mythological deities of the sun and the moon Apollo and Diana.
native: Depicted is the cycle of the year, embodied by the four seasons, the 12 zodiac signs, and the ancient mythological deities of the sun and the moon Apollo and Diana.

en: In the parade bedroom, the magnificent bed from the era of Frederick I immediately captures your attention as you step inside.
zh: 在遊行臥室中，弗雷德里克一世時代的華麗床鋪一進門便吸引你的目光。
ja: 行列用の寝室には、フリードリヒ1世の時代の壮麗なベッドが入るとすぐに目を引きます。
local: In the parade bedroom, the magnificent bed from the era of Frederick I immediately captures your attention as you step inside.
native: In the parade bedroom, the magnificent bed from the era of Frederick I immediately captures your attention as you step inside.

en: Beds embellished with the most exquisite textiles for their canopies, curtains, and covers were undoubtedly some of the most stunning furniture pieces in any majestic palace.
zh: 床上裝飾著最精美的紡織品，包括天篷、窗簾和被罩，無疑是任何宏偉宮殿中最華麗的家具之一。
ja: 天蓋やカーテン、カバーに最も精巧な織物が施されたベッドは、どの壮麗な宮殿でも間違いなく最も見事な家具の一つでした。
local: Beds embellished with the most exquisite textiles for their canopies, curtains, and covers were undoubtedly some of the most stunning furniture pieces in any majestic palace.
native: Beds embellished with the most exquisite textiles for their canopies, curtains, and covers were undoubtedly some of the most stunning furniture pieces in any majestic palace.

en: In most of these costly beds, however, sleep was almost never truly experienced there.
zh: 然而，在這些昂貴的床上，睡眠幾乎從未真正發生過。
ja: しかし、これらの高価なベッドの多くでは、実際にそこで眠ることはほとんどありませんでした。
local: In most of these costly beds, however, sleep was almost never truly experienced there.
native: In most of these costly beds, however, sleep was almost never truly experienced there.

en: As part of the parade apartment, the room was mainly intended to be viewed and marbled at.
zh: 作為遊行公寓的一部分，這個房間主要是用來展示和觀賞的。
ja: 行列用のアパートの一部として、この部屋は主に鑑賞されるためのものでした。
local: As part of the parade apartment, the room was mainly intended to be viewed and marbled at.
native: As part of the parade apartment, the room was mainly intended to be viewed and marbled at.

en: Therefore, private audiences were even conducted in this very space.
zh: 因此，私下會見甚至在這個空間中進行。
ja: そのため、私的な謁見もこの場所で行われました。
local: Therefore, private audiences were even conducted in this very space.
native: Therefore, private audiences were even conducted in this very space.

en: This room also played a significant role in the ceremonial traditions that dictated the weddings of the royal family.
zh: 這個房間在規範皇室婚禮的儀式傳統中也扮演了重要角色。
ja: この部屋はまた、王室の結婚式を規定する儀式の伝統において重要な役割を果たしました。
local: This room also played a significant role in the ceremonial traditions that dictated the weddings of the royal family.
native: This room also played a significant role in the ceremonial traditions that dictated the weddings of the royal family.

en: Between 1700 and 1888, a great many weddings were joyously celebrated at Charlottenburg.
zh: 在1700年至1888年間，許多婚禮在夏洛滕堡歡慶舉行。
ja: 1700年から1888年の間に、多くの結婚式がシャルロッテンブルクで喜びに満ちて祝われました。
local: Between 1700 and 1888, a great many weddings were joyously celebrated at Charlottenburg.
native: Between 1700 and 1888, a great many weddings were joyously celebrated at Charlottenburg.

en: At the conclusion of the festivities, the court entourage accompanied the newlyweds all the way to this room.
zh: 慶典結束時，宮廷隨從陪同新婚夫婦一路來到這個房間。
ja: 祝宴の終わりに、宮廷の随行員が新婚夫婦をこの部屋まで付き添いました。
local: At the conclusion of the festivities, the court entourage accompanied the newlyweds all the way to this room.
native: At the conclusion of the festivities, the court entourage accompanied the newlyweds all the way to this room.

en: Historical records, however, remain entirely silent on whether the wedding night also took place here.
zh: 然而，歷史記錄對於婚禮當晚是否也在此舉行則完全沒有記載。
ja: しかし、歴史的記録は結婚初夜がここで行われたかどうかについては一切沈黙しています。
local: Historical records, however, remain entirely silent on whether the wedding night also took place here.
native: Historical records, however, remain entirely silent on whether the wedding night also took place here.

en: The present arrangement of paintings in the parade room is inspired by the original interior design and furnishings from the time of Frederick the Great in the mid-18th century century.
zh: 遊行室中現有的畫作陳設靈感來自18世紀中葉腓特烈大帝時期的原始室內設計與家具。
ja: 行列の間にある現在の絵画の配置は、18世紀中頃のフリードリヒ大王の時代の元の内装デザインと家具に触発されています。
local: The present arrangement of paintings in the parade room is inspired by the original interior design and furnishings from the time of Frederick the Great in the mid-18th century century.
native: The present arrangement of paintings in the parade room is inspired by the original interior design and furnishings from the time of Frederick the Great in the mid-18th century century.

en: The portraits crafted between 1680 and 1700, some of which were already hung in this very space at that time, depict members of the English royal family and individuals who were closely related to the king both by blood and politically.
zh: 1680年至1700年間創作的肖像畫，其中一些當時已掛在此處，描繪了英國皇室成員及與國王有血緣和政治密切關係的人士。
ja: 1680年から1700年の間に制作された肖像画の中には、当時すでにこの場所に掛けられていたものもあり、イギリス王室のメンバーや血縁や政治的に王と密接な関係にある人物が描かれています。
local: The portraits crafted between 1680 and 1700, some of which were already hung in this very space at that time, depict members of the English royal family and individuals who were closely related to the king both by blood and politically.
native: The portraits crafted between 1680 and 1700, some of which were already hung in this very space at that time, depict members of the English royal family and individuals who were closely related to the king both by blood and politically.

en: Among the significant features of the room are also the four intricately designed cabinets, each embellished with exotic lacquer paintings.
zh: 房間的重要特色還包括四個精緻設計的櫃子，每個櫃子都裝飾有異國風情的漆畫。
ja: 部屋の重要な特徴の一つに、異国風の漆絵で飾られた四つの精巧なキャビネットがあります。
local: Among the significant features of the room are also the four intricately designed cabinets, each embellished with exotic lacquer paintings.
native: Among the significant features of the room are also the four intricately designed cabinets, each embellished with exotic lacquer paintings.

en: The precious furniture was carefully crafted to securely store important documents or intriguing trinkets, which were displayed to visitors during special occasions for their admiration.
zh: 這些珍貴家具精心製作，用於安全存放重要文件或有趣的小飾品，並在特殊場合展示給訪客欣賞。
ja: 貴重な家具は重要な書類や興味深い小物を安全に保管するために丁寧に作られ、特別な機会に訪問者に見せて鑑賞されました。
local: The precious furniture was carefully crafted to securely store important documents or intriguing trinkets, which were displayed to visitors during special occasions for their admiration.
native: The precious furniture was carefully crafted to securely store important documents or intriguing trinkets, which were displayed to visitors during special occasions for their admiration.

en: The substantial lock ensured they were safe from thieves.
zh: 堅固的鎖確保它們免受竊賊侵害。
ja: 頑丈な鍵が盗難から守っていました。
local: The substantial lock ensured they were safe from thieves.
native: The substantial lock ensured they were safe from thieves.

en: Between the windows, you can spot a wind indicator positioned right above the mirror.
zh: 窗戶之間，你可以看到一個風向指示器，位於鏡子正上方。
ja: 窓の間には、鏡のすぐ上に風向計が設置されています。
local: Between the windows, you can spot a wind indicator positioned right above the mirror.
native: Between the windows, you can spot a wind indicator positioned right above the mirror.

en: This linked through a gear mechanism to a weather vein mounted on the roof.
zh: 它透過齒輪機構連接到安裝在屋頂上的風向標。
ja: これは歯車の仕組みを通じて屋根に取り付けられた風見鶏に連結されています。
local: This linked through a gear mechanism to a weather vein mounted on the roof.
native: This linked through a gear mechanism to a weather vein mounted on the roof.

en: This way, the wind direction can also be conveniently monitored from inside the room.
zh: 這樣一來，風向也可以從房間內方便地監測。
ja: このようにして、風向は部屋の中からも簡単に確認できます。
local: This way, the wind direction can also be conveniently monitored from inside the room.
native: This way, the wind direction can also be conveniently monitored from inside the room.

en: Next to the bed lies a small bathroom, featuring its sunken marble basin and the advanced luxury of running water, it was crafted as a remarkable technical innovation that would have astonished visitors even during the Baroque period.
zh: 床旁有一間小浴室，配有下沉的大理石洗臉盆和先進的自來水設施，這是一項令人驚嘆的技術創新，即使在巴洛克時期也會讓訪客驚訝。
ja: ベッドの隣には小さな浴室があり、沈み込んだ大理石の洗面台と先進的な流水設備を備えています。これはバロック時代でさえ訪問者を驚かせる素晴らしい技術革新でした。
local: Next to the bed lies a small bathroom, featuring its sunken marble basin and the advanced luxury of running water, it was crafted as a remarkable technical innovation that would have astonished visitors even during the Baroque period.
native: Next to the bed lies a small bathroom, featuring its sunken marble basin and the advanced luxury of running water, it was crafted as a remarkable technical innovation that would have astonished visitors even during the Baroque period.

en: Unlike the state bed, the bath was most probably used by the king himself, as he could conveniently reach it from his private living quarters through a small discreet passageway.
zh: 與國家床不同，浴室很可能是國王本人使用，因為他可以通過一條小而隱蔽的通道，方便地從私人居所到達這裡。
ja: 国家用のベッドとは異なり、この浴室はおそらく王自身が使用しており、小さく目立たない通路を通って私的な居住区から便利にアクセスできました。
local: Unlike the state bed, the bath was most probably used by the king himself, as he could conveniently reach it from his private living quarters through a small discreet passageway.
native: Unlike the state bed, the bath was most probably used by the king himself, as he could conveniently reach it from his private living quarters through a small discreet passageway.

en: Sophie Charlotte lived relatively independently at Leadsonburg Palace.
zh: 索菲·夏洛特在利德森堡宮相對獨立地生活。
ja: ゾフィー・シャルロッテはリードソンブルク宮殿で比較的独立して生活していました。
local: Sophie Charlotte lived relatively independently at Leadsonburg Palace.
native: Sophie Charlotte lived relatively independently at Leadsonburg Palace.

en: After the palace was ceremoniously inaugurated in 1699, the summer residence was later expanded by Eosander Fongutter into a representative three-wing complex.
zh: 宮殿於1699年正式啟用後，夏季住所後來由伊奧桑德·方古特擴建成一個具有代表性的三翼建築群。
ja: 1699年に宮殿が正式に開館した後、夏の離宮はイオサンダー・フォンガッターによって代表的な三翼の複合施設に拡張されました。
local: After the palace was ceremoniously inaugurated in 1699, the summer residence was later expanded by Eosander Fongutter into a representative three-wing complex.
native: After the palace was ceremoniously inaugurated in 1699, the summer residence was later expanded by Eosander Fongutter into a representative three-wing complex.

en: Sophie Charlotte was a staunch opponent of the politics led by Prime Minister Dankelmann.
zh: 索菲·夏洛特堅決反對首相丹克爾曼領導的政治。
ja: ゾフィー・シャルロッテは首相ダンケルマンが主導する政治に強く反対していました。
local: Sophie Charlotte was a staunch opponent of the politics led by Prime Minister Dankelmann.
native: Sophie Charlotte was a staunch opponent of the politics led by Prime Minister Dankelmann.

en: After his fall in 1697, in which she had played a significant role, she withdrew to her castle Leadsonburg, as she was unable to wield any political influence at the Berlin court.
zh: 在1697年他倒台後，她因扮演重要角色而退出政治，退居利德森堡城堡，因為她無法在柏林宮廷施加政治影響力。
ja: 1697年の彼の失脚後、彼女は重要な役割を果たしたため、ベルリン宮廷で政治的影響力を持てず、リードソンブルク城に引きこもりました。
local: After his fall in 1697, in which she had played a significant role, she withdrew to her castle Leadsonburg, as she was unable to wield any political influence at the Berlin court.
native: After his fall in 1697, in which she had played a significant role, she withdrew to her castle Leadsonburg, as she was unable to wield any political influence at the Berlin court.

en: From 1696 until her death, she took in the orphaned Caroline of Brandenburg Aronsbach as her foster daughter, who was subsequently cared for by Sophie Charlotte's mother, the Electress Sophie of Hanover, with her grandson, George of Hanover, who would later ascend to the throne as King George II of England.
zh: 從1696年直到她去世，她收養了布蘭登堡-阿龍斯巴赫的孤兒卡羅琳作為養女，後來由索菲·夏洛特的母親漢諾威選侯夫人索菲與她的孫子漢諾威的喬治照顧，喬治後來成為英國喬治二世國王。
ja: 1696年から亡くなるまで、彼女はブランデンブルク＝アーロンスバッハの孤児キャロラインを養女として迎え入れ、その後ゾフィー・シャルロッテの母であるハノーファー選帝侯ゾフィーと、その孫で後にイギリス王ジョージ2世となるジョージ・オブ・ハノーファーによって世話されました。
local: From 1696 until her death, she took in the orphaned Caroline of Brandenburg Aronsbach as her foster daughter, who was subsequently cared for by Sophie Charlotte's mother, the Electress Sophie of Hanover, with her grandson, George of Hanover, who would later ascend to the throne as King George II of England.
native: From 1696 until her death, she took in the orphaned Caroline of Brandenburg Aronsbach as her foster daughter, who was subsequently cared for by Sophie Charlotte's mother, the Electress Sophie of Hanover, with her grandson, George of Hanover, who would later ascend to the throne as King George II of England.

en: On February 1st, 1705, Sophie Charlotte passed away from a throat infection during her visit to her mother in Hanover.
zh: 1705年2月1日，索菲·夏洛特在訪問漢諾威的母親時因喉嚨感染去世。
ja: 1705年2月1日、ゾフィー・シャルロッテはハノーファーで母親を訪ねている際に喉の感染症で亡くなりました。
local: On February 1st, 1705, Sophie Charlotte passed away from a throat infection during her visit to her mother in Hanover.
native: On February 1st, 1705, Sophie Charlotte passed away from a throat infection during her visit to her mother in Hanover.

en: Following the Queen's passing, the king made the heartfelt decision to rename the estate of Leadsonburg to Charlotte and Berg in honor of his late wife.
zh: 女王去世後，國王懷著深情決定將利德森堡莊園改名為夏洛特與貝格，以紀念已故的妻子。
ja: 女王の死後、王は故妻を称えてリードソンブルクの領地をシャルロッテ・アンド・ベルクと改名するという心からの決断をしました。
local: Following the Queen's passing, the king made the heartfelt decision to rename the estate of Leadsonburg to Charlotte and Berg in honor of his late wife.
native: Following the Queen's passing, the king made the heartfelt decision to rename the estate of Leadsonburg to Charlotte and Berg in honor of his late wife.

en: Leibniz, who outlived Sophie Charlotte by 11 years, wrote after her passing that she frequently desired my presence nearby, so I often had the privilege of engaging in conversations with the princess, whose intellect and humanity were unmatched by anyone else.
zh: 萊布尼茨比索菲·夏洛特多活了11年，他在她去世後寫道，她經常希望我在身邊，因此我常有幸與這位智慧與人性無人能及的公主交談。
ja: ゾフィー・シャルロッテより11年長生きしたライプニッツは、彼女の死後、彼女が頻繁に私の近くにいてほしいと望んでいたため、知性と人間性において他に類を見ない王女と会話する特権をしばしば得たと書いています。
local: Leibniz, who outlived Sophie Charlotte by 11 years, wrote after her passing that she frequently desired my presence nearby, so I often had the privilege of engaging in conversations with the princess, whose intellect and humanity were unmatched by anyone else.
native: Leibniz, who outlived Sophie Charlotte by 11 years, wrote after her passing that she frequently desired my presence nearby, so I often had the privilege of engaging in conversations with the princess, whose intellect and humanity were unmatched by anyone else.

en: The Queen possessed an incredible knowledge even in obscure fields and an extraordinary thirst for learning, and in our conversations, she continually strove to fulfil and expand that desire even further, from which one day a substantial and lasting benefit for the public would have undoubtedly emerged had death not tragically claimed her life.
zh: 女王即使在冷門領域也擁有驚人的知識，並有非凡的求知慾，在我們的對話中，她不斷努力滿足並擴展這種渴望，若非死神悲劇奪去她的生命，這將為公眾帶來重大且持久的利益。
ja: 女王はあまり知られていない分野でも驚くべき知識を持ち、学びへの並外れた渇望を抱いていました。私たちの会話の中で、彼女はその欲求を満たしさらに広げようと絶えず努力し、もし死が彼女の命を奪わなければ、いつの日か公衆にとって重要で永続的な利益が確実に生まれていたでしょう。
local: The Queen possessed an incredible knowledge even in obscure fields and an extraordinary thirst for learning, and in our conversations, she continually strove to fulfil and expand that desire even further, from which one day a substantial and lasting benefit for the public would have undoubtedly emerged had death not tragically claimed her life.
native: The Queen possessed an incredible knowledge even in obscure fields and an extraordinary thirst for learning, and in our conversations, she continually strove to fulfil and expand that desire even further, from which one day a substantial and lasting benefit for the public would have undoubtedly emerged had death not tragically claimed her life.

en: Over 2,700 porcelain pieces are meticulously organised within the cabinet, carefully sorted by size and function.
zh: 櫥櫃中精心排列著超過2700件瓷器，按大小和功能仔細分類。
ja: キャビネットには2700点以上の磁器が細かく整理され、サイズや用途ごとに丁寧に分類されています。
local: Over 2,700 porcelain pieces are meticulously organised within the cabinet, carefully sorted by size and function.
native: Over 2,700 porcelain pieces are meticulously organised within the cabinet, carefully sorted by size and function.

en: The glazed walls amplify the impression of dazzling wealth and seemingly endless abundance.
zh: 釉面牆壁增強了令人眼花繚亂的富裕感和似乎無盡的豐饒印象。
ja: 釉薬がかかった壁は、まばゆいばかりの富と果てしない豊かさの印象を強めています。
local: The glazed walls amplify the impression of dazzling wealth and seemingly endless abundance.
native: The glazed walls amplify the impression of dazzling wealth and seemingly endless abundance.

en: The ceiling painting was created around 1706 by Anthony Coxy.
zh: 天花板畫作約於1706年由安東尼·考克西創作。
ja: 天井画は1706年頃にアンソニー・コクシーによって描かれました。
local: The ceiling painting was created around 1706 by Anthony Coxy.
native: The ceiling painting was created around 1706 by Anthony Coxy.

en: The central theme of the artwork is the expulsion of night by the day.
zh: 這幅藝術作品的主題是白天驅逐黑夜。
ja: この作品の中心テーマは、昼が夜を追い払うことです。
local: The central theme of the artwork is the expulsion of night by the day.
native: The central theme of the artwork is the expulsion of night by the day.

en: In the centre, on her chariot drawn by eight horses appears aurora, the goddess of dawn.
zh: 中央是由八匹馬拉著戰車的黎明女神奧羅拉。
ja: 中央には、八頭の馬に引かれた戦車に乗る暁の女神オーロラが描かれています。
local: In the centre, on her chariot drawn by eight horses appears aurora, the goddess of dawn.
native: In the centre, on her chariot drawn by eight horses appears aurora, the goddess of dawn.

en: In ether chariot, the night plunges down with her children, the light triumphs and emerges as the radiant central force of the world.
zh: 在以太戰車中，夜晚與她的孩子們一同墜落，光明勝利並成為世界輝煌的核心力量。
ja: エーテルの戦車の中で、夜は子供たちと共に沈み、光が勝利して世界の輝く中心的な力として現れます。
local: In ether chariot, the night plunges down with her children, the light triumphs and emerges as the radiant central force of the world.
native: In ether chariot, the night plunges down with her children, the light triumphs and emerges as the radiant central force of the world.

en: Sophie Charlotte did not live to witness the porcelain cabinet being fully completed.
zh: 索菲·夏洛特未能親眼見證瓷器櫥櫃的完全完成。
ja: ゾフィー・シャルロッテは磁器のキャビネットが完全に完成するのを見届けることはできませんでした。
local: Sophie Charlotte did not live to witness the porcelain cabinet being fully completed.
native: Sophie Charlotte did not live to witness the porcelain cabinet being fully completed.

en: The designs for it, however, she most likely did have the opportunity to see.
zh: 然而，她很可能有機會看到它的設計圖。
ja: しかし、その設計図は彼女が見る機会を持っていた可能性が高いです。
local: The designs for it, however, she most likely did have the opportunity to see.
native: The designs for it, however, she most likely did have the opportunity to see.

en: Furthermore, with her passion for porcelain and her collection, she laid the foundation for the magnificent execution by her husband.
zh: 此外，憑藉她對瓷器的熱愛和收藏，她為丈夫的華麗實現奠定了基礎。
ja: さらに、彼女の磁器への情熱とコレクションにより、夫による壮麗な実現の基礎が築かれました。
local: Furthermore, with her passion for porcelain and her collection, she laid the foundation for the magnificent execution by her husband.
native: Furthermore, with her passion for porcelain and her collection, she laid the foundation for the magnificent execution by her husband.
